reason: Check credential-use audit event contracts, Settings risk summary stability/sanitization, and security-sensitive test coverage.
Check new audit/diagnostic failures return sanitized errors and do not leak secrets, SQL, command output, file content, or export payloads.
Check no audit/log/error contains private keys, passwords, tokens, file/terminal streams, unsafe command output, executor config, or exported secrets.
Check no unnecessary schema change; if any schema changes appear, paired migration and UTC safety rules apply.
Check handler/audit/settings/frontend contract consistency and boundary validation.
Check credential audit helpers and SSH purpose constants are reused across surfaces rather than duplicated.
Check implementation covers researched P1b surfaces and respects bounded background-worker decision.
Check P1b builds on P1 core event model and does not regress prior least-privilege/audit behavior.
